notes.title: Halloween night
notes.content:
[h1]Especially for Halloween, we prepared a huge level where you are expected:[/h1]

    👹 four new dangerous monsters
    ⚙️ unique mechanics
    🐾 interaction of heroes
    🎶 and also new tracks from Origami Repetika!

Don't miss the opportunity to help the friends survive this Halloween night!

notes.title: Version 2.2 Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Physics and Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed movement on moving platforms
[*] Improved tactility of jumping to different heights
[*] Fixed Bluey's attack
[*] Improved movement control of the characters
[/list]
[h1][b]Menu and Level Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added character change buttons to the level select menu
[*]  Introductory levels are shorter now
[/list]
